connector.name: Agenticpay
connector.registryDescription: x402 USDC paywall bridge for MCP - pay per tool call on Solana.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-bridge. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the krystiangw account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: AGENTICPAY_BRIDGE_KEYPAIR
env.description: Solana keypair as 64-byte JSON array (the format `solana-keygen new` writes). The bridge signs each x402 payment with this keypair.

env.name: AGENTICPAY_BRIDGE_TOOLS
env.description: JSON array of paid tool definitions. Each entry: { name, description, url, inputSchema, headers? }
